editorial_intent: Diagram how severe hepatic protein restriction induces mitochondrial bioenergetic collapse and cytokinesis failure in hepatocytes, driving systemic hyperammonemia that inhibits skeletal muscle mTORC1 protein synthesis.
subject: Dual-panel hepatic-skeletal cross-section: on the left, shrunken polygonal hepatocytes containing fragmented mitochondrial rings and stalled binucleated cleavage furrows; on the right, striated skeletal muscle fibers undergoing proteasomal degradation under a shower of microscopic hexagonal ammonia nodes.
setting: Framed by interlocking epithelial tight-junction palisade blocks and subtle ascending vagal nerve meridian curves echoing Bauhaus architectural grid structures.
composition: Asymmetric split-panel lithograph layout with a left-to-right metabolic gradient vector; heavy Constructivist diagonal grid lines connecting the diminished hepatic block to the degrading muscular bundle across a stark void.
